pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: What have you been doing?
paragraphs: Ana has been painting all week. The living room and kitchen are finished; the bedroom is next. She has been running for two weeks and has baked three cakes this week. Kim has returned from visiting family in Korea. These are episode facts, not new occupations.

pages.title: Welcome back

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Hi, Ana! I’m back! Wow… your living room is blue!
lines.audioText: Hi, Ana! I’m back! Wow… your living room is blue!
lines.translation: Oi, Ana! Voltei! Nossa… a sua sala está azul!

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Welcome back! Yeah, I’ve been painting all week
lines.audioText: Welcome back! Yeah, I’ve been painting all week.
lines.translation: Bem-vinda de volta! É, passei a semana toda pintando

lines.text: Almost. I’ve painted both rooms, the living room and the kitchen. The bedroom is next

pages.title: Activities and results
pages.instruction: Listen for the activity, the result and the follow-up question

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: And your shoes! Have you been running?
lines.audioText: And your shoes! Have you been running?
lines.translation: E esse tênis! Você anda correndo?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes! I’ve been running every morning for two weeks
lines.audioText: Yes! I’ve been running every morning for two weeks.
lines.translation: Sim! Estou correndo toda manhã há duas semanas

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Every morning? Wow. And there’s a cake on the table. You’ve even been baking!
lines.audioText: Every morning? Wow. And there’s a cake on the table. You’ve even been baking!
lines.translation: Toda manhã? Nossa. E tem um bolo na mesa. Você até anda fazendo bolo!

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Ha! Yes. I’ve baked three cakes this week. Anyway, how was Korea?
lines.audioText: Ha! Yes. I’ve baked three cakes this week. Anyway, how was Korea?
lines.translation: Ha! Sim. Fiz três bolos esta semana. Enfim, como foi a Coreia?

questions.prompt: How long has Ana been running?
questions.answer: Ana has been running for two weeks

questions.prompt: How many cakes has she baked this week?
questions.answer: Ana has baked three cakes this week

pages.title: React and continue
pages.instruction: Listen for the activity, the result and the follow-up question

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Great! I visited my family and ate a lot. But I have jet lag. I’ve been sleeping all day!
lines.audioText: Great! I visited my family and ate a lot. But I have jet lag. I’ve been sleeping all day!
lines.translation: Ótima! Visitei a minha família e comi muito. Mas estou com jet lag. Passei o dia todo dormindo!

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Oh no! You seem tired. Here, have some cake
lines.audioText: Oh no! You seem tired. Here, have some cake.
lines.translation: Ah, não! Você parece cansada. Toma, come um pedaço de bolo

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Of course! I always say yes to cake
lines.audioText: Of course! I always say yes to cake.
lines.translation: Claro! Eu sempre digo sim para bolo

pages.title: Catch up with a friend
pages.instruction: Choose a topic, share recent activities and ask about mine

pages.title: A message from Leo
pages.instruction: Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana! It’s Leo. We’ve finished the invitations for the party, so that’s one thing off the list. We’ve also seen eleven possible places now, but we haven’t chosen one yet. We’ve been visiting places every weekend for three weeks, and it’s taking longer than I expected. Carla wants space for dancing, while I’d be happy with a barbecue in the park. Could you help us think about what matters most before we book another visit? The invitations are ready, but the venue decision is still open
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana! It’s Leo. We’ve finished the invitations for the party, so that’s one thing off the list. We’ve also seen eleven possible places now, but we haven’t chosen one yet. We’ve been visiting places every weekend for three weeks, and it’s taking longer than I expected. Carla wants space for dancing, while I’d be happy with a barbecue in the park. Could you help us think about what matters most before we book another visit? The invitations are ready, but the venue decision is still open.
